summary: Creates or converts cube-map textures from per-face inputs, vertical crosses, or horizontal crosses for reflection and GLSL workflows.

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Conversion mode: onepersidetocubemap, verticalcrosstocubemap, cubemaptoverticalcross, horizontalcrosstocubemap, or cubemaptohorizontalcross

common_gotchas: Six separate inputs must be connected in +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z order.
Input layout must match Mode or faces will be scrambled.
GLSL cube maps use samplerCube rather than sampler2D.
Mismatched face resolution or orientation appears as seams or broken reflections.
key_concepts: Cube Map TOP builds TouchDesigner cube-map texture format from face images or cross layouts.
Mode can convert vertical or horizontal crosses to cube maps and cube maps back to cross layouts.
Phong MAT can use cube maps for reflection workflows.
Render TOP can produce cube-map inputs, and GLSL samples them with samplerCube.
Face ordering and orientation are critical for seamless reflections.
